# V3 Marketing & Customer Acquisition Operating Guide

This is the doctrinal source for MarketForge. The full text lives in `${HOME}/Downloads/compass_artifact_wf-dd9ed4e7-0129-48c1-afcd-57208b3d3367_text_markdown.md` (user-supplied deep research).

For convenience and offline reference, MarketForge ships with this synthesized executive summary. For the full text including all citations, evidence grades, and worked examples, refer to the original document.

---

## Quick reference

### Scope
- Digital businesses, SaaS, DTC, mobile apps, B2C subscription, marketplaces, creator businesses, agencies, local service, hardware DTC.
- Out of scope: enterprise B2B (ACV >$100K), multi-billion-dollar consumer brands, FMCG, telco/utilities/banks/airlines.

### Budget tiers
- T1: $0-500/mo
- T2: $500-5K/mo
- T3: $5K-25K/mo
- T4+: $25K+/mo (outside default scope)

### Evidence grades
- A: Peer-reviewed academic research
- B: Large-scale industry data (Pew, Baymard, IPA, Klaviyo, Ahrefs, ANA/DMA)
- C: Practitioner consensus across multiple credible operators
- D: Vendor-promoted (hypothesis, not fact)
- E: Folklore / single-case anecdote

### AI-automatable
- 🤖🤖🤖 fully automatable
- 🤖🤖 substantially automatable
- 🤖 modestly helpful
- ❌ judgment-only

## The 14 sections of the V3 guide

1. **Foundations & Strategy** — Positioning (Dunford), JTBD (Moesta + Ulwick), Awareness stages (Schwartz), Mental availability (Sharp/Romaniuk), Brand vs Performance (Binet/Field — pressure-tested), 95-5 rule (Dawes — with counter-evidence), Founder-market fit (Rachleff), Retention truth (Balfour), Compound vs linear channels.

2. **Research & Market Intelligence** — JTBD switch interviews, The Mom Test (Fitzpatrick), Review mining / VOC, Buyer personas (Revella vs JTBD synthesis), SparkToro, Competitive analysis sources.

3. **Organic Acquisition Channels** — SEO post-AIO (honest 2025-2026 reality), GEO/LLMO, Content marketing (POV + bottom-funnel + original research), LinkedIn organic (founder + employees), X/Twitter organic, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Community-led growth (moat-vs-theater test), Email marketing, Podcast hosting + guesting, Word-of-mouth + referral (K-factor math), PR & earned media (post-HARO replacements), Engineering as marketing / free tools, Founder content / personal brand, Newsletter sponsorships.

4. **Paid Acquisition Channels** — Google Ads (Search + PMax + Shopping + YouTube), Meta Ads (Advantage+ + Andromeda), TikTok Ads (Spark Ads), LinkedIn Ads (Thought Leader Ads discipline), Reddit Ads, X/Twitter Ads, Pinterest Ads, Programmatic / display (Hoffman critique), Apple Search Ads + Google UAC (mobile apps + CPP discipline), Newsletter sponsorships (paid), Influencer marketing (FTC + fake-influencer caveat), Affiliate marketing (PartnerStack pattern), Sponsorships, Retargeting (post-cookie reality).

5. **Outbound Channels** — Cold email (deliverability + saturation), Cold LinkedIn outreach, Cold calling (when it fits), Direct mail in 2024-2026 (counterintuitive resurgence + ANA/DMA), ABM tiers (1:1 / 1:few / 1:many — theater check), SMS marketing for DTC (Klaviyo benchmarks + TCPA).

6. **Conversion & CRO** — Landing page principles, Cialdini's 7 principles (honest application), Pricing as marketing/positioning lever (Ramanujam, Simon), A/B testing discipline (when SMBs should + shouldn't), Baymard checkout research (DTC), Onboarding and activation (PLG critical), Self-reported attribution surveys.

7. **Lifecycle, Retention & Expansion** — Email lifecycle flows (Klaviyo benchmarks), Push notifications (web + mobile), In-app messaging, Loyalty programs, Referral programs (K-factor reality), Customer marketing & advocacy, Customer service as marketing.

8. **Measurement & Attribution** — The death of clean attribution (post-iOS 14.5), Self-reported attribution (Fishkin/SparkToro), Marketing mix modeling (Meta Robyn / Google Meridian), Incrementality testing (geo holdouts), LTV:CAC + payback math, Dark social / dark funnel (Refine Labs attribution mirage), Attention measurement (Nelson-Field), Kill criteria channel-specific.

9. **AI-Native Marketing Workflows (2025-2026)** — Content generation (what works / what produces slop), AI for cold email personalization, AI for ad creative variants, AI agents for outbound, AI for SEO/GEO content strategy, The "AI slop" backlash, Custom agents per workflow.

10. **Organizational & Process** — Brian Balfour's Four Fits, Bullseye Framework (Weinberg & Mares — updated for 2026), Quarterly planning, OKRs, Hire vs outsource vs AI, Distinctive brand assets (Romaniuk, Sharp).

11. **Underrated / Evidence-Backed Tactics** — Pratfall effect (Aronson 1966), Spiegel negative reviews research, Distinctive brand assets, Mere exposure (Zajonc, 1968; Bornstein 1989), Sharp / specific numbers (Schindler-Yalch 2006), The Rule of 7 debunk, Survivor bias on case studies.

12. **The Decision Matrix** — Project classification (8+ dimensions), Pre-marketing readiness check (7 gates), Channel × business-model fit matrix, Channel scoring algorithm (7 factors 1-5), Portfolio construction (3-leg model), Differential kill/scale criteria, Scenario playbooks (12 examples A-L), Anti-patterns to flag (12 named), When to override the matrix, When to recommend doing less (or no marketing).

13. **Biases, Blind Spots, Honest Caveats** — Survivor bias, Commercial bias map (with table), Channel decay, Replicability, The credentialed contrarian view (Hoffman, Ritson, Sharp), Attribution honesty, AI-driven channel saturation timelines.

14. **Appendices** — Glossary, Bibliography (categorized by source quality A-E), "What the data shows vs what marketers say" comparison table.

## Key 2026 realities (selected highlights)

### SEO post-AIO is grim
- Pew Research (March 2025, 68,879 searches): CTR drops from 15% to 8% when AI Overviews appear; only 1% of users click cited sources.
- Ahrefs (December 2025, 300K keywords): position-1 CTR fell 58% on AIO queries.
- HubSpot organic traffic: 13.5M (Nov 2024) → ~6.1M (Jan 2025).

What still works: bottom-funnel commercial queries, brand SEO, local SEO, being cited in AIOs.

### Cold email reply rates have collapsed
- Average B2B reply: 8.5% (2019) → 6.8% (2023) → ~3.43% (2026).
- Top performers still hit 5-15%.
- Signal-based personalization: 15-30% reply.
- Template-fill AI personalization: 3-4% reply (saturated).

### LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads dominate
- ZenABM 2026 (161,256 ads, 211 companies): 2.68% CTR vs 0.42% for Single Image (6.4x), at $2.29 CPC vs $13.23 (77% cheaper per LP click).

### Mobile UA: ASA dominates for iOS-heavy subscription
- Mature subscription apps: 60-70% ASA / 30-40% UAC.
- CPP-referred traffic: 156% conversion lift (Apple Developer).
- Growth by Kev Feb 2026: "ASA at $8 CPI with $60 LTV (7.5x ROAS) dramatically more efficient than UAC at $4 CPI with $12 LTV (3x ROAS)."

### Attribution is broken
- Post-iOS 14.5: deterministic last-click broken.
- DTC platform-reported routinely over-attributes 20-50%.
- Triangulate platform + CAPI + self-report + incrementality.
- Refine Labs example: podcast attributed to 53% of revenue via self-report, 0% via software attribution.

### Direct mail counterintuitive resurgence (for ABM)
- ANA/DMA 2025: direct mail response 4.4% vs email 0.12% (37x gap).
- ABM dimensional mailers: 5-15% response, near-100% open.
- 3x higher meeting-set rates vs email-only when mail precedes call.

### Email lifecycle flows dominate campaigns
- Klaviyo 2025-2026: flows generate up to 30x revenue per recipient vs campaigns.
- SMS flows: 7.6% of sends but 45.2% of SMS revenue.

### Apple MPP inflated email opens
- Since Sept 2021: iOS opens inflated ~70%.
- Use clicks, replies, revenue/recipient as real KPIs.

## Anti-patterns to flag (V3 §12.8)

1. Spending on acquisition before retention is solid — leaky bucket.
2. Picking channels by founder preference, not buyer presence.
3. Premature scaling of paid before product-channel fit.
4. Optimizing for vanity metrics.
5. Treating channel mix as set-and-forget.
6. A/B testing without traffic.
7. Confusing brand and performance budgets.
8. "Build it and they will come" content strategy.
9. Outsourcing strategy.
10. Ignoring dark social / self-report attribution.
11. **Copying playbooks from companies 100x bigger.** Chris Walker: "Marketers that continue to copy the Salesforce playbook from 2006 for their 50-person SaaS company will continue to struggle."
12. "AI everything" — AI-generated cold email and content backfires in 2025-2026.

---

## When to recommend doing less or no marketing (V3 §12.10)

- Pre-PMF (D30 retention curve declining) → STOP, do interviews and product work.
- Cash runway <6 months without PMF → marketing won't fix this.
- Product has no repeat use case but sold as subscription → fix the model first.
- Team of 2 trying to run 8 channels → pick 2.
- Founder refuses the channel they're best positioned for → next-best underperforms.
